title: Heart Sutra
speaker: Red Pine
summary: Red Pine takes up the Heart Sutra in a question-and-answer session, reading it line by line as an attack on the Sarvastivadin Abhidharma. Red Pine explains emptiness as the negation of a negation: to give a table self-existence draws a line around it and denies everything else. Avalokiteshvara answers Shariputra, the great logician, with set theory, as form and emptiness intersect and then prove identical. Red Pine reads the mantra's "gate" as "into the gone," a motion into the womb of Prajnaparamita, and jokes that the closing "svaha" echoes the self the Sarvastivadins sought. The session ends with translation as dancing with Avalokiteshvara, neither on the feet nor across the room.
